findings.title: StarLake sidecar schema is narrower than the Zijin .source.json contract
findings.detail: C3 requires full field enumeration (fiscal_year/company_name/security_id/provider_document_id/content_sha256/byte_size/fiscal_period=FY) for the Zijin FY2025/FY2024 sidecars only; those all bind exactly (content_sha256 == measured hash, byte_size == 79925886/32100114, fiscal_period=FY, company_name=紫金矿业, security_id=601899). The Dropbox StarLake sidecar binds via content_sha256 (eb965857... == measured file) and carries fiscal_year=2024/security_id=688031/provider_document_id=1223325316/document_kind=annual_report, but omits byte_size/fiscal_period/company_name fields. This satisfies the card's 'StarLake sidecar binds' and the test's assertions, so it is non-blocking, but the sidecar would not support a byte_size/fiscal_period binding check.

findings.title: AUD2-05 verified via temp variant, not by renaming real samples
findings.detail: The missing-sample probe copied the test into %TEMP% with the Zijin FY2025 path pointed at a nonexistent file; the suite failed hard with the 'blocked, never swap samples' message (3 failed/7 passed) and real sample files were never touched. Equivalently proves a missing sample is blocked, not swapped.
